title: ETS Provenance Android Phase 1A Hardware Qualification Profile
purpose: Apply the common ETS HQP contract to the existing ETS Mobile Phase 1A physical-device qualification boundary without defining a mobile-only evidence methodology.

capability_boundary.claim_statement: Qualification applies only to the named Android device/build/application/profile combination and does not establish semantic truth, production attestation, Gateway sync, remote durability, or qualification of other Android devices.

device_constraints.notes: Android security implementation, OS/build fingerprint, application build, and signing identity are claim-critical. A result does not silently transfer between devices or materially different platform security implementations.

test_cases.title: Bind physical Android device and application build
test_cases.purpose: Retain exact device, OS/build, application, source, signing-certificate, and Keystore capability identity before product-specific qualification cases execute.
pass_criteria: Manufacturer/model, Android release/API level/build fingerprint, application version, source Git SHA, CI run, and APK signing-certificate digest are retained.
Keystore security level and hardware-backed tri-state reflect the live runtime capability report rather than requested capability.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use a designated qualification device and retain no private key or secret application credential.

test_cases.title: ETS-controlled still capture preserves exact committed bytes
test_cases.purpose: Map Phase 1A Test A into HQP stimulus/observation/result evidence while preserving the existing MECB semantics.
pass_criteria: The committed artifact is the exact CameraX adapter byte stream with no ETS rewrite before commitment.
Independent SHA-256 and provenance-envelope digest checks match the retained Evidence Object.
The retained public key verifies the origin signature over the exact signed payload.
The artifact remains ETS_CAPTURED and COMMITTED_LOCAL with no remote-durability or truth claim introduced.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use synthetic or non-sensitive imagery; do not alter production capture behavior to satisfy the test.

test_cases.title: Android Keystore capability is reported conservatively
test_cases.purpose: Map Phase 1A Test B into retained evidence without treating hardware-backed keys as proof of semantic truth.
pass_criteria: Live runtime and provenance-envelope security classifications match.
Software-enforced keys are never represented as hardware-backed.
Unavailable StrongBox or TEE capability is recorded as observed rather than inferred or upgraded.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Do not export, replace, or deliberately destroy private key material merely to produce qualification evidence.

test_cases.title: Pre-existing image remains ETS_IMPORTED
test_cases.purpose: Map Phase 1A Test D into HQP while proving that later hashing, signing, commitment, export, or verification cannot upgrade origin classification.
pass_criteria: The selected pre-existing device image is committed as ETS_IMPORTED.
Digest, signature, provenance, and local replay checks succeed without changing the origin class.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use a non-sensitive pre-existing image whose origin classification is known before the test.

test_cases.title: Committed mobile evidence survives cold-process restart
test_cases.purpose: Map Phase 1A Test C into HQP resulting-state evidence using an actual process-destroy/relaunch boundary.
pass_criteria: The current process session differs from the sessions that performed CAPTURE and IMPORT.
Both retained Evidence Objects replay from the journal with original classes, digests, and COMMITTED_LOCAL state.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use Android Force stop or an equivalent process-destroy action; Activity recreation alone is insufficient.

test_cases.title: Negative and interruption cases fail closed
test_cases.purpose: Map Phase 1A Test E into a bounded negative-case evidence record without weakening production persistence or recovery behavior.
pass_criteria: Denied/failed capture or import attempts do not produce a successful Evidence Object claim.
Corrupted artifact or journal state fails closed.
Any targeted instrumentation exercises the same persistence/recovery boundary and does not weaken production behavior.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Prefer bounded test instrumentation over destructive platform manipulation when a real failure cannot be induced deterministically.
